root_cause: Fee configuration error causing MDR to be applied to fee‑exempt RuPay credit UPI transactions.
diagnosis: The acquirer/gateway is incorrectly applying a default merchant discount rate to RuPay credit UPI payments, which are mandated to be fee‑free, resulting in systematic overcharges.
action_rationale: Auditing the gateway's fee configuration will reveal and allow correction of the erroneous MDR mapping for RuPay credit UPI.
